company.name: Relay
company.summary: Relay 是面向实体运营的行动系统（system of action for physical operations），服务不坐在办公桌前的 80% 全球一线劳动力。其系统结合软件与 AI 平台及专为一线打造的下一代硬件，捕捉一线人员的言语与行为，并将其转化为既有系统中的行动，帮助团队提升沟通、安全与生产力。

evidence_refs.quote: said Chris Chuang, CEO and Co-Founder of Relay
Relay, the system of action for physical operations, today announced it has raised $36 million in new funding, bringing total capital raised to over $90 million.
Relay is the system of action for physical operations, serving the 80 percent of the world’s workforce that doesn’t sit behind a desk – the frontlines.
Investment round led by industrial leader International Paper, alongside other new investors Cerity Partners, Harmonic Growth Partners, and Thayer Investment Partners

As a signal of Relay’s growing leadership in industrial digital transformation, the round was led by International Paper, a Fortune 500 leader in sustainable packaging solutions, with more than 125 years of manufacturing experience.

products.name: Relay 一线运营系统
products.description: 结合云通信、AI、实时翻译、位置感知和自动化工作流的系统，配合专为一线打造的现代耐用硬件。工人像过去几十年一样拿起对讲机、佩戴并按键通话，背后系统将言语转化为结构化、可搜索的记录，并接入既有运营系统。
products.target_customers: 制造业、酒店业、医疗等行业的一线团队与企业客户
features: 专为一线打造的下一代硬件

evidence_refs.quote: With Relay, workers simply continue communicating how they have for decades — pick up a radio, wear it during their shift, and push to talk. But behind that familiar interaction is a robust system that combines the power of cloud communications, AI, real-time translation, location awareness, and automated workflows - all packaged in modern, durable, next-gen hardware built specifically for the frontlines.

Relay’s system combines its powerful software and AI platform with purpose-built next-gen hardware, to better connect frontline teams, overcome language barriers with support for 35 languages, and deliver rapid ROI for its customers.

analysis.capital_judgment: 本轮资本押注的核心变量是：Relay 能否将一线语音通信转化为可查询、可行动的运营智能，并在制造业与酒店业等实体运营场景中形成规模化部署与高留存。已验证信号包括：本轮由 International Paper 领投且显著超额认购，累计融资超 9000 万美元；服务数十万一線工人，覆盖约 10% 财富 500 强，拥有 99% 毛收入留存率和 130% 净收入留存率，每周处理超 10 亿数据点，部署近 1 万个站点。判断的证据边界在于：来源未披露本轮估值、具体轮次名称及收入金额，留存率与部署规模为披露口径，尚未经独立审计验证。
validated_signals: 本轮由 International Paper 领投，Cerity Partners 的客户、Harmonic Growth Partners、Thayer Investment Partners 参投，早期领投方 G2 Venture Partners 和 Wind River Ventures 追加投资
